title: Instrument
axis: numeric treatment and structural measured-by device: dense 38 px rows; F1 as a bar, precision and recall as needles on one shared graduated 0-40 % scale, decimal-aligned mono numerals; who measured a row is a left rail (solid cream = measured by us, dashed steel = published by Open Code Review) that joins across adjacent rows of one run and breaks when a sort interleaves them
worse_at: busiest reading: three tracks of ink per row slow a one-number glance; the shared scale compresses if any metric ever leaves the 0-40 range and makes small gaps look like steps; on the phone only F1 keeps its gauge without a swipe and 56 px rows show about nine rows per screen; the dashed rail can read as a dim solid line on low-contrast screens, leaving the words to carry the distinction
